fields.title: Article / latest-headline record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope. Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (failed URLs are not written to the dataset -- they are reported in the ERRORS record of the run's key-value store). Article-mode records (S1-nextdata) carry the WordPress post object verbatim from the site's __NEXT_DATA__ payload (title/content/excerpt/date fields/author/categories/tags/featuredImage) plus a flattened articleBody convenience field; latest-mode records (S2-rss, site-wide feed) carry title/link/creator-style fields plus the full article HTML from <content:encoded>. Upstream fields are passed through close to verbatim, so extra fields beyond those listed here may also appear.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The exact input value (article URL, or 'latest') that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which extraction strategy emitted this record (S1-nextdata for articles, S2-rss for latest headlines, or 'none' on failure).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

title.title: Title
title.description: Article headline. Article mode: WordPress post title. Latest mode: RSS item title.

content.title: Content (raw HTML)
content.description:
Full article body as raw WordPress HTML (

,

articleBody.title: Article body (plain text)
articleBody.description: Full article text flattened to plain text (paragraphs joined with blank lines) from the raw HTML `content` field. Convenience field, not present upstream.

excerpt.title: Excerpt
excerpt.description: Short dek/teaser as raw HTML, from the WordPress post object (article mode only).

description.title: Description
description.description: Teaser text from the RSS item (latest mode only).

slug.title: Slug
slug.description: URL slug of the article (article mode only).

status.title: Status
status.description: WordPress publish status, e.g. "publish" (article mode only).

date.title: Date (local)
date.description: Publish date/time in the site's local timezone (article mode only).

dateGmt.title: Date (GMT)
dateGmt.description: Publish date/time in GMT/UTC (article mode only).

modifiedGmt.title: Modified date (GMT)
modifiedGmt.description: Last-modified date/time in GMT/UTC (article mode only).

uri.title: URI
uri.description: Site-relative URI path of the article (article mode only).

link.title: Link
link.description: Article URL, from the RSS item (latest mode only).

guid.title: GUID
guid.description: RSS item GUID, matches the article URL (latest mode only).

author.title: Author
author.description: Raw-passthrough author object from WPGraphQL (node.name, node.slug, node.avatar etc) (article mode only).

creator.title: Creator
creator.description: Byline name from the RSS <dc:creator> element (latest mode only).

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: Article mode: raw-passthrough WPGraphQL categories object (edges[].node.name/slug). Latest mode: plain list of RSS <category> text values.

tags.title: Tags
tags.description: Raw-passthrough WPGraphQL tags object (edges[].node.name/slug) (article mode only).

featuredImage.title: Featured image
featuredImage.description: Raw-passthrough WPGraphQL featured image object (node.sourceUrl/altText/caption/mediaDetails) (article mode only).

image.title: Image
image.description: Lead image URL from the RSS <media:thumbnail> element (latest mode only).

id.title: GraphQL ID
id.description: Base64-encoded WPGraphQL global ID (article mode only).

databaseId.title: Database ID
databaseId.description: Numeric WordPress post ID (article mode only).

__typename.title: GraphQL type
__typename.description: WPGraphQL type name, always "Post" (article mode only).

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across both article and latest-headline records.
